task.title: Cai lich kiem dinh ky tren may Mac (launchd) de tu bat loi staple/lech moc truoc khach
task.detail: WIN da kiem: tren node-2 KHONG co timer/cron kiem dinh ky nao => loi staple 22/09 khong ai bat duoc truoc khach. Script co san nhung la launchd macOS (server/Windows khong doc duoc DMG): scripts/install-release-audit-watch.sh (mac dinh 6 gio/lan, tai file DANG PHAT cua moi kenh, doc version + kiem DMG, alert Telegram khi lech). VIEC: cd <checkout nhanh main tren Mac> && bash scripts/install-release-audit-watch.sh ; kiem launchctl list | grep release-audit ; bao log o ~/.local/state/vpnflow-release-audit/.
task.verify: Bao: da cai, launchctl list thay job, va 1 vong chay dau tien (log JSONL) ket qua ra sao.
